item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00453","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C25","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 is a direct and material drafting template for the child. The child expressly supersedes the November 8, 1960 order and reproduces its overall machinery: broad delegation to State, a detailed delegation to Defense with exclusions, assignments to Treasury and Commerce, reservation of specified presidential functions, allocation and reallocation of funds, personnel provisions, definitions, references to amended statutes and orders, supersession, and saving clauses. Several specialized provisions are carried forward with only statutory citations or institutional details updated, including munitions control, special missions abroad, Commerce's investment-promotion function, and the overseas-personnel thirty-month rule. C25 and C18 are earlier ancestors of the same foreign-aid administrative framework, but C21 is the immediate and substantially closer textual source.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Exclusive of the functions otherwise delegated, or reserved to the President, by the provisions of this order, and subject to the provisions of this order, there are hereby delegated to the Secretary of State ... all functions conferred upon the President","parent_excerpt":"Exclusive of the functions otherwise delegated, or excluded from delegation, by this order, and subject to the provisions of this order, there are hereby delegated to the Secretary of State all functions conferred upon the President","explanation":"Near-verbatim opening delegation formula, adapted to the new Foreign Assistance Act and related statutes."},{"child_excerpt":"Designations, including changes in designations, by the Secretary of articles which shall be considered as arms, ammunition, and implements of war, including technical data relating thereto ... shall have the concurrence of the Secretary of Defense.","parent_excerpt":"Designations, including changes in designations, by the Secretary of State of articles which shall be considered as arms, ammunition, and implements of war, including technical data relating thereto ... shall have the concurrence of the Secretary of Defense.","explanation":"A distinctive, specialized munitions-control provision is carried forward almost verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"Funds appropriated or otherwise made available to the President for carrying out the Act shall be deemed to be allocated without any further action of the President ... There are allocated to the Secretary of State ... There are allocated to the Secretary of Defense","parent_excerpt":"Funds heretofore or hereafter appropriated or otherwise made available to the President for carrying out the Act shall be deemed to be allocated or advanced without any further action of the President ... There are allocated to the Secretary of State ... There are allocated to the Secretary of Defense","explanation":"The same automatic fund-allocation mechanism and State/Defense division are reused and simplified for the new statute."},{"child_excerpt":"Persons appointed, employed, or assigned after May 19, 1959 ... shall not ... be entitled to the benefits provided by section 528 of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 in cases in which their service ... exceeds thirty months.","parent_excerpt":"Persons appointed, employed, or assigned after May 19, 1959 ... shall not ... be entitled to the benefits provided by section 528 of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 in cases in which their service ... exceeds thirty months.","explanation":"This detailed personnel rule is reproduced essentially verbatim, with only the governing section citation updated."},{"child_excerpt":"Except to the extent that they may be inconsistent with this order, all determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements, and other actions ... shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or terminated by appropriate authority.","parent_excerpt":"Except to the extent that they may be inconsistent with this order, all determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements, and other actions ... shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or terminated by appropriate authority.","explanation":"The saving provision is duplicated, reinforcing direct reuse within the broader parallel administrative structure."}]}
